name: Dalaran Jewelcrafter's Token
description: Tiffany Cartier's shop in Dalaran will gladly accept these tokens for unique jewelcrafting recipes.

name: Epicurean's Award
description: Visit special cooking vendors in Dalaran and the capital cities to to purchase unusual cooking recipes, spices, and even a fine hat!

name: Honor Points DEPRECATED
description: If you can read this, you've found a bug. REPORT IT!

Strand of the Ancients Mark of Honor

name: Champion's Seal
description: Awarded for valiant acts in the Crusader's Coliseum.

name: Isle of Conquest Mark of Honor
Illustrious Jewelcrafter's Token
description: Awarded for demonstrating great skill in jewelcrafting, these tokens can be used to purchase unique jewelcrafting plans and the fabulous Chimera's Eye.

name: Tol Barad Commendation
description: Awarded for brave deeds performed on Tol Barad.

name: Justice Points
description: Used to purchase less-powerful armor and weapons.

name: Valor Points
description: Used to purchase powerful PvE armor and weapons.

name: Ironpaw Token
description: Represents your credit with the Ironpaw family of cooks. Can be redeemed for Cooking ingredients and other things at the Stockmaster in Halfhill Market.

name: Mark of the World Tree
description: Granted by the Guardians of Hyjal. Can be used to purchase reinforcements for the Invasion of the Firelands.

name: Darkmoon Prize Ticket
description: Awarded for winning games or doing favors at the Darkmoon Faire.

name: Mote of Darkness
description: Extracted from the forces of Deathwing, this dark energy can be used to power amazing magics.

name: Essence of Corrupted Deathwing
description: Extracted from Deathwing himself, this dark energy powers the most fearsome of incantations.

name: Elder Charm of Good Fortune
description: Possession of the Elder Charm of Good Fortune allows its lucky owner to risk a coin to receive a bonus reward from Mogu'shan Vaults, Heart of Fear, Terrace of Endless Spring, Sha of Anger, or Salyis' Warband.

name: Zen Jewelcrafter's Token
description: Awarded for demonstrating great skill in jewelcrafting, these tokens can be used to purchase unique jewelcrafting plans and the beautiful Serpent's Eye.

name: Lesser Charm of Good Fortune
description: Possession of the Lesser Charms of Good Fortune will result in great happiness and the eventual conversion into Warforged Seals, which allow players to risk a coin to receive a bonus reward from raid encounters.

name: Mogu Rune of Fate
description: Possession of the Mogu Rune of Fate allows its lucky owner to risk a rune to receive a bonus reward from the Throne of Thunder, Nalak or Oondasta.

name: Warforged Seal
description: Possession of the Warforged Seal allows its lucky owner to risk a seal to receive a bonus reward from the Siege of Orgrimmar, the Celestial Trials, and Ordos.

name: Timeless Coin
description: You feel the shadowy fingers of previous and future owners of this coin playing across your hand, as if time itself blurs. Spend upon the Timeless Isle to earn powerful and fluid rewards.

name: Bloody Coin
description: Pulled from the steaming corpses of foes vanquished in the mists of the Timeless Isle.

name: Black Iron Fragment
description: Scavenged from the shattered armor and weapons of Iron Horde invaders.

name: Apexis Crystal
description: The enduring legacy of a lost civilization, Apexis crystals contain untold reserves of magical power.

name: Garrison Resources
description: Earn resources to build-up and expand your garrison.

name: Secret of Draenor Alchemy
description: Allows you to obtain new Alchemy recipes from the Alchemist's Lab.

name: Artifact Fragment
description: A tiny fragment of an Ashran lost artifact, treasured by the Highmaul Ogres.

name: Dingy Iron Coins
description: Perhaps they're more valuable than they appear on the surface.

name: Seal of Tempered Fate
description: Twists fate to provide an opportunity for additional treasure in Highmaul or Blackrock Foundry raids.

name: Secret of Draenor Tailoring
description: Allows you to obtain Tailoring recipes from the Tailoring Emporium.

name: Secret of Draenor Jewelcrafting
description: Allows you to obtain new Jewelcrafting recipes.

name: Secret of Draenor Leatherworking
description: Allows you to obtain Leatherworking recipes from the Tannery.

name: Secret of Draenor Blacksmithing
description: Allows you to obtain new Blacksmithing recipes.

name: Oil
description: Found primarily in Tanaan Jungle, Oil is used to fuel naval missions.

name: Seal of Inevitable Fate
description: Twists fate to provide an opportunity for additional treasure in Hellfire Citadel or Draenor Mythic Dungeons.

name: Sightless Eye
description: A rough, hand-minted coin. It bears a symbol similar to that of the Kirin Tor, with one key difference: the eye is closed.

name: Shadowy Coins
description: Prized by pickpockets and marks alike. Can be spent in the Underbelly below Dalaran.

name: Ancient Mana
description: Concentrated magic from the ancient leylines beneath Suramar.

name: Timewarped Badge
description: Earned in Timewalking dungeons. Exchanged for goods from Timewalking Vendors in capitol cities.

name: Artifact Knowledge
description: Increases the rate at which you earn Artifact Power.

name: Valor
description: A currency used to increase the power of items from Hellfire Citadel, Tanaan Jungle, Draenor Dungeons, and powerful crafted items.

name: Order Resources
description: Used to recruit troops, run missions, and research upgrades for your order hall.

name: Nethershard
description: A fragment of crystallized nether brought to Azeroth by the Legion.

name: Timeworn Artifact
description: A mysterious naga artifact from the depths of the Great Sea. King Mrgl-Mrgl is looking for these at Timeworn Strand.

name: Seal of Broken Fate
description: Twists fate to provide an opportunity for additional treasure from Legion raid and Mythic dungeon bosses.

name: Curious Coin
description: This unusual coin is warm to the touch and vibrates gently in your hand. Used to procure items from Xur'ios in Dalaran.

name: Brawler's Gold
description: Awarded to victors of the Brawler's Guild. Use it to purchase Rumble Cards and other world-altering items at the Brawler's Gold Exchange vendor.

name: Lingering Soul Fragment
description: Soul fragment once belonging to a powerful enemy.

name: Horde Qiraji Commendation
description:
Completing this quest will grant the Horde credit in the Call of the Scarab event.

The faction which earns the most credit today may hang their banners by the Scarab Gong for the rest of the year.

name: Alliance Qiraji Commendation
description:
Completing this quest will grant the Alliance credit in the Call of the Scarab event.

The faction which earns the most credit today may hang their banners by the Scarab Gong for the rest of the year.

name: Legionfall War Supplies
description: Used to further the construction of valuable structures on the Broken Shore.

name: Legionfall Building - Personal Tracker - Mage Tower (Hidden)
Legionfall Building - Personal Tracker - Command Tower (Hidden)
Legionfall Building - Personal Tracker - Nether Tower (Hidden)
Felessence
description: Concentrated demonic essence which can be captured and used to create armor of great power.

name: Echoes of Battle
description: Used to purchase powerful PvP armor. At the end of the season, this currency converts to gold.

name: Echoes of Domination
description: Used to purchase elite PvP armor. At the end of the season, this currency converts to gold.

name: Trial of Style Token
description: Earned by participating in the Trial of Style. Can be exchanged for transmoggable gear in most major cities.

name: Coins of Air
description: Evaporate into mist after a while.

name: Writhing Essence
description: Used to upgrade Legion Legendary items to item level 970.

name: Argus Waystone
description: Used by the minions of Sargeras to force open portals from Argus to other Legion-controlled worlds.

name: Veiled Argunite
description: This dull-colored crystal is highly valued by ethereal traders, especially Thaumaturge Vashreen aboard the Vindicaar.

name: Wakening Essence
description: Used by Arcanomancer Vridiel in Dalaran above the Broken Isles to create or upgrade Legion Legendary items.
